### Do AI appointment reminders actually reduce no-shows?

The average appointment-based business loses 15–25% of its revenue to no-shows. Talos builds multi-touch AI reminder sequences that combine voice calls, SMS, and email at the right intervals — cutting no-shows 30–50%.
